title: Community Solidarity in Action:Mashwara Group Raises ₹55,000 in Just 4 Days for 15-Year-Old Rizwana’s Kidney Transplant
summary: Community Solidarity in Action: Mashwara Group Raises ₹55,000 in Just 4 Days for 15-Year-Old Rizwana’s Kidney Transplant
body:
Demonstrating remarkable community backing, the Mashwara Group and like-minded individuals successfully raised and handed over ₹55,000 in a span of just four days to support 15-year-old Rizwana from Keirao. The financial assistance was organized following a social media appeal detailing the family's extreme financial distress, which rendered them unable to afford crucial kidney dialysis and transplant procedures.
During the formal handover ceremony on November 6, 2026, senior group member Mufti Imran praised the collective efforts of members and appealed to the broader public to step forward with support. Emphasizing the spirit of communal harmony, Mufti Imran also extended heartfelt gratitude to the Meitei community members who contributed generously to the cause, transcending barriers of caste and religion.
